notes.title: Version 0.1 - Starting from scratch
notes.content:
This 0.1 is a simple reset of everything. We created a completely new project from scratch. Everything starts in a small scene with the house of the family of our main character Richard. 

First Milestones:
- Creating a closed area (Version 0.1)
- Creating the house of the family 
- Starting of the implementation of the story

Please test whether you can leave this closed area. If you are able to leave the area, please let us know on Discord.

https://discord.gg/C28fKBaXP8

Thanks for testing! 

Fabian & Ben

notes.title: Upcoming December Release v0.3
notes.content:
[h1]Version 0.3 is coming this month[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40993824/47175bf81229992c10c55a778e3c866feb9ce4d3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40993824/892a820fd36a94eae21727c22cf25ef64aaff493.png[/img]

[h3]Hey guys! [/h3]
We will release [b]this month[/b] our next test version 0.3! 

Here is a little overview of the upcoming content:
[list]
[*] Wildlife
[*] Creatures
[*] Death / Damage
[*] Little Side-Quests
[*] The Emptiness
[*] Improvement of lighting
[*] Terrain improvements
[*] Environment improvements
[*] New Location: Graveyard
[*] Bug fixes
[*] New Character Tool 
[*] New music and sounds
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40993824/aced2c3b170f00afa0b79347ecc2fde6fb3a55af.png[/img]

[h2]Important[/h2]

Please note that these are only alpha versions for testing. The goal is always to collect bugs, collect feedback and ideas from you guys. It's not a Beta! 
Less performance and bugs are normal. [b]Everything is a work in progress!
[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40993824/24ea72db4026e57a1a3c9d4861b6216d67dfe206.png[/img]

[h2]Hardware Requirements[/h2]

We noticed that Caught in Nowhere has heavy performance issues on GTX1060 (or similar) and we try to make it playable by adding more graphic settings. But at the moment it's not our focus to support these types of GPUs so we apologize if you have trouble playing the Playtest of Caught in Nowhere. We really hope that we can kind of fix that issue!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40993824/f84b7076fc39fc05e0e8578d1a8126789cea71b5.png[/img]

We wish you all a great month and we're looking forward to your feedback!


Thanks for all your support! 

Fabian Moeller
Creator & Developer 

Ben Hopkins 
Sound Lead / Composer

notes.title: Version 0.2.3.1 - Hotfix
notes.content:
[h1]Version 0.2.3.1 - Hotfix[/h1]

[h2]Following bugs should be fixed: [/h2]

[list]
[*] "Deers are not running away" is working (kind of)
[*] "Richard stuck on stair" works much better
[*] Main Menu alignment should be correct now
[*] Missing in-game menu in Richards refuge is back 
[*] "Richard stuck in the bathtub" should be fixed in 90% of all cases
[*] "Richard stuck in the ditch" can happen, but less frequently now
[*] Richard should now be able to leave the refuge without landing back inside
[*] Player shouldn't see anymore Richards body, when stuck in objects
[*] Richard can't run through trees anymore
[/list]

[h2]Good to know:[/h2]

[*] When you enter the open world, it takes about 10 sec before the FPS is constant.
[*] Graphic Settings can causes problems in special cases. Will be fixed soon!

notes.title: Join our Discord Server!
notes.content:
[url=https://discord.gg/BxsHgdKT]Discord Link[/url]

[h2]Goal[/h2]
[b]Our goal is to get a great community with many ideas for the game! [/b]
Be a part of this community, share your thoughts, share your ideas, report bugs, and so on! 

[b]Help us to make Caught in Nowhere as good as possible![/b]

[h2]Decisions[/h2]
You are also a part of making important decisions for the gameplay of Caught in Nowhere.

For example: 
At the moment we are working with "hide & seek", but if the community says that weapons or whatever would be much better for Caught in Nowhere, we will add weapons or whatever you want.

Join our [url=https://discord.gg/BxsHgdKT]Discord[/url] server now! We are glad for every single person. 

Best regards
Fabian
